notes: Areas: Kalat State (total; = Sarawan + Jhalawan + Kachhi + Dombki-Kaheri Country + Makran + Kharan) and Las-Bela State; both are parts of the STATES block printed on leaf 395/396. Last opening of Table XV Part II. Printed figures kept where arithmetic disagrees; in every case a bold '3' appears to print/scan as '8': (1) Kalat State TOTAL col 19 printed 18, but its rows give 13 (only Lahnda 19/13/6) and P-F = 19-6 = 13. (2) Sarawan TOTAL cols 36/38 printed 187 / 80 (P=M+F holds with M=107) but Part I Sarawan females 12,919 - col 5 total 12,889 = 30, and Kalat State col 36/38 (589/158) equals the sum of divisions only with Sarawan 137/30. (3) Dombki-Kaheri Country TOTAL col 37 printed 8; P-F = 11-8 = 3 and Part I males 14,553 - 14,550 = 3. (4) Makran TOTAL col 38 printed 58; P-M = 161-108 = 53 and Part I females 31,979 - 31,926 = 53. Makran TOTAL col 37 printed '1C8' with a broken middle digit, read 108 (= Part I 36,483 - 36,375). With these implied values Kalat State col 36-38 = sum of divisions (589/431/158) and all 'All other' figures agree with Part I (area total minus col 3-5 total).
